constraints.action: Patients with ARDS must receive at least 5 cmH2O of positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP) at the time of diagnosis
Patients not receiving positive pressure ventilation cannot be considered to have ARDS
Use low tidal volume ventilation strategies (4–8 mL/kg predicted body weight)
Measure and adjust tidal volume using predicted body weight (PBW)
Use prolonged high-pressure recruitment maneuvers (airway pressure ≥ 35 cmH2O for at least one minute)
Routine use of brief high-pressure recruitment maneuvers (airway pressure ≥ 35 cmH2O for less than one minute) is discouraged

Start prone positioning in patients with ARDS receiving invasive mechanical ventilation early after intubation, after stabilization with low tidal volume and PEEP adjustment, and when PaO2/FiO2 remains < 150 mmHg
Proning should be applied for prolonged sessions of 16 consecutive hours or more
Routine use of continuous infusions of NMBA to reduce mortality in moderate-to-severe ARDS not due to COVID-19
Use of ECCO2R for treatment of ARDS not due to COVID-19 to prevent mortality outside of randomized controlled trials

Patients with severe ARDS not due to COVID-19 (per EOLIA trial criteria) must be treated with ECMO in an ECMO center meeting defined organizational standards using a management strategy similar to the EOLIA trial
